englishSummary.headline: Managed Home Screen authentication wording clarified
englishSummary.summary: The app-exclusion setting description now spells out “Managed Home Screen” instead of using the abbreviation “MHS” when referring to authentication.
englishSummary.adminImpact: Administrators can more easily identify that the setting applies while Managed Home Screen requires authentication.
